exchanges: Okay so I've finally got a minute to sit down, today has been absolutely chaotic. The washing machine flooded the utility room this morning and I spent like an hour with towels before work, and then the bus was late, so yeah. How are you?
That sounds like a rough start. I'm glad you've got a moment to breathe now; did the machine survive?
Barely! Kwame had a look at it when he got back off his night shift, he's a paramedic so he's used to dealing with messes I guess, and he reckons the hose just came loose
Handy to have someone calm in a crisis around. A loose hose is a much better outcome than a broken pump.
Yeah honestly. I'll have to tell Mrs Lindqvist anyway because it's her machine and she likes to know about everything, she's very particular
Some landlords are like that, though at least she's engaged. Does she live nearby?
Two streets over. She used to be a dentist before she retired and she still inspects everything like she's looking for cavities lol, she checked the grout in the bathroom last time
Ha, that's a very specific kind of thoroughness. Hopefully the grout passed.
It did, just about. Anyway I'm planning a barbecue in the back garden for Saturday if the weather holds, I want to invite a few of the neighbours too
That sounds fun, and a nice way to get to know people. How many are you thinking?
Maybe ten or twelve? I need to be careful with food because Kwame is allergic to peanuts, a proper serious one, he carries the pen thing
Good to plan around that from the start. Checking labels on sauces and snacks will matter a lot.
Yeah satay is definitely off the menu. Sam said she'd bring her speaker, she's always got music on when she comes back from work on that little Vespa of hers, you can hear her coming down the road
A soundtrack and an entrance, nice. A speaker will make the garden feel like a proper party.
She's great. Oh and I should probably invite the family next door too, the dad is also called Sam funnily enough, so we've got two Sams on the go
That'll make shouting across the garden interesting. Do you get on with that family?
Yeah they're lovely, they've got three kids and the dad Sam drives this massive minivan that takes up half the street when he parks
With three kids that's probably a necessity. Parking must be a daily puzzle around there.
It really is, the whole road is permit parking and nobody has enough spaces. Mr Rossi from the deli on the corner complains about it constantly because his deliveries can't get in
Deliveries in tight streets are a nightmare. Does the deli do good food at least?
The best. His focaccia is unreal, I'll probably get some for Saturday
Fresh bread at a barbecue is always a win. Maybe some of his cured meats too.
Good shout. Also Mrs Chen at the bakery said she might do a cake if I order by Thursday, she's so sweet, she remembered my name after one visit
That's the kind of local shop that makes a neighbourhood feel like home. A cake would round things off nicely.
Right? Okay I just remembered Ayesha, our other housemate, is away that weekend, she's at her cousin's wedding in Birmingham
Shame she'll miss it, but a wedding is a good reason. Maybe save her some cake.
Definitely. She'll be gutted, she loves a barbecue
Maybe you can do a smaller one when she's back.
Hmm maybe. So I've been thinking about what to cook, burgers obviously, some halloumi for the veggies, corn
A solid line-up. Halloumi always disappears first.
Every time. Kwame's going to man the grill apparently, he says it's his calling
Confidence is half the battle at a grill. Hopefully he's got tongs and patience.
Oh god wait, I got that totally wrong earlier. It's not peanuts Kwame is allergic to, it's shellfish. I was mixing him up with my brother. So the prawns are out but the satay could be fine
Good thing you caught that before shopping. Skewers without seafood it is, and keep the grill clean of anything fishy.
Phew yes. My brother would've been fine at that point lol
Ha, well, both of them are covered now. Is your brother coming?
No he lives in Glasgow, too far
Fair enough, that's a long trip for a burger.
Haha yes. Mrs Lindqvist texted back about the washing machine by the way, she's sending her handyman on Monday
That's quick for a landlord. Hopefully it's just the hose and a simple fix.
Hopefully. She also asked if the barbecue would be loud, so I've invited her too to keep her happy
Smart move, it's hard to complain about a party you're at.
Exactly my thinking. She probably won't come though, she goes to bed at nine
Then the invite costs nothing and earns goodwill.
Yep. Ugh I still need to buy charcoal
Add it to the list before you forget; it's the one thing you can't improvise.
Ha true. Oh and Mr Rossi just popped his head out when I was passing the deli, he's shutting for a month because he's going home to Sardinia to see his mum
A month back home sounds wonderful for him. You might want to grab the focaccia before he goes.
Yeah I'll go Friday. He said his nephew might open it some days but not sure
Better to stock up while you can, just in case.
Will do. Right, I need to sleep
Get some rest, you've had a long day.

questions.message: What does Sam, my housemate, ride to work again?
What was Mrs Lindqvist's job back in the day?
Kwame's the one with the shellfish allergy, right? Just double checking before I buy food
Where's Mr Rossi heading for his month off?
What does Ayesha drive, does she even have a car?
Honestly I could fall asleep standing up, tomorrow is going to be a long one.
